tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
创建笔记API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能
优化笔记组织功能

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database schema for notes with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags, and implement it using an ORM or database queries.
T1.notes: Ensure scalability and flexibility for future features like attachments or sharing.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on notes, including endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes.
T2.notes: Secure the API with authentication and validation mechanisms.

T3.implementation_approach: Build a responsive front-end page using a framework like React or Vue.js to display, create, and edit notes.
T3.notes: Focus on user-friendly design and seamless integration with the API.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a search feature using full-text search or indexing tools like Elasticsearch to allow users to find notes by keywords or tags.
T4.notes: Optimize for performance with large datasets.

T5.implementation_approach: Introduce features like categorization, tagging, or folder structures to help users organize notes more effectively.
T5.notes: Consider user feedback to prioritize the most useful organization methods.
